craft_notes: Sthāyin: demotic aside (who this is for). Rows: row 1 (confused/pompous pair). Rupture: dash after sake — purpose, then persons. Close: men (who's excluded). Rejected: 'ritualists' for kriyāḍambara — killed: pomp-keeping keeps the text's own scorn-word; 'beginners' — killed: fancy-struck kept.

lines: For meditation's sake — confused minds, pompous-rite
l4.sanskrit_cite: dhyānārtham bhrāntabuddhīnāṃ kriyāḍambaravartinām | kevalaṃ varṇitam puṃsāṃ vikalpanihatātmanām

reads_against.argmap: For whom is this merely described? → Description serves meditation, not pomp — fancy-struck men get words only.
c1_essence: Described for meditation's sake, for fancy-struck men only.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with jijñāsā (wonder sharpened into seeking)
